name: Northpoint Orbital
clause: §7.2 Service Credits. Where a scheduled contact loses 50% or more of its planned downlink time for reasons within Provider's control, Customer is credited 100% of the pass fee; smaller losses are credited pro rata. §9.1 Excused Events. Credits do not apply to geomagnetic storms of NOAA G4 or greater (Kp ≥ 8) or to maintenance notified at least seven (7) days in advance.

name: Polar Data Systems
clause: §6.3 Credits. Loss of 60% or more of a contact for Provider-side causes earns a credit equal to the full pass fee; partial loss is credited in proportion to minutes lost over 60% of the contact. §11 Force Majeure. Provider is excused for space weather at or above NOAA G3 (Kp ≥ 7), solar radio bursts affecting the band in use, and maintenance notified 72 hours in advance.

name: Aether Dynamics
clause: Schedule B, Service Levels. A contact is Failed when 60% or more of its planned duration produces no usable downlink. Failed contacts are credited at 100% of the pass fee; degraded contacts pro rata. Exclusions: geomagnetic activity of Kp 7 or higher as published by NOAA SWPC; customer-side configuration; notified maintenance (72 h).

name: Kestrel Earth Imaging
clause: 4.1 Credits are issued where at least 75% of a contact is lost due to Provider equipment; lesser losses are credited pro rata. 4.4 No credit is owed for losses during geomagnetic storms of G2 (Kp 6) or above, for passes below 8° maximum elevation, or for maintenance notified 72 hours ahead.

name: Nexus Corp
clause: Credits: 75% contact loss or more due to Provider = full pass fee, otherwise pro rata. Excluded: space weather of Kp 6 or above; passes peaking below 8° elevation (best effort); planned maintenance with 72 hours written notice.

name: SkyNet Communications
clause: Standard Terms §3. Credits are pro rata to minutes of contact lost for reasons within Provider's control. Space weather of NOAA G1 or above (Kp ≥ 5), passes below 10° elevation, and maintenance announced 48 hours in advance are excluded.

name: Helix Orbital
clause: Standard Terms §3 (new account). Credits are pro rata to minutes lost for Provider-side causes. Excluded: Kp ≥ 5 space weather, passes below 10° elevation, maintenance announced 48 hours ahead.

name: Orbital Sciences Inc
clause: §7.2 Service Credits as in the Platinum MSA: full pass fee for 50% or more lost for Provider-side reasons, pro rata below. §9.1 Excused: Kp ≥ 8, maintenance with seven days notice.
